title: Coffee
copy: Our favourite coffee spot? Our own kitchen. If Julian's around, he'll gladly make you a coffee. The next nearest good coffee is the Jack's Point golf clubhouse, a lovely place to spend an hour or two with a stunning view.

title: Getting up the mountain
copy: On busy days, leave around 7am to beat the queues and the traffic. Chat with us the night before and we'll tell you what the morning looks like.
